description: Nova execution quality for portrait 9:16: frame-0 hook card with punch-in, hero-metric one-number statline variant with pop, dark broadcast editorial identity.
primary_publishing_shape: Short-form vertical video; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Use large expressive Vietnamese hooks, condensed numeric display type, tactile but purposeful pitch marks, layered color and restrained kinetic motion. Open on a hook card: 5-8 word claim in condensed display type with a lime rule, punched in at frame 0. Select tactical, statline, source, and chart plates by story beat; a statline with one hero metric renders as a single 3x numeral with pop. Omit subtitles and use only reviewed evidence. Keep statline, chart, and source graphics on their own compositions: head-to-head split scoreboard; labeled zero-baseline chart; archival pull-quote source note. Chart type follows data meaning: bars/columns for category comparisons, line for ordered time series, pie/donut only for a verified part-to-whole with at most four parts.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
